chapter.heading: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah.
chapter.v:
Oh clap
your hands, all you nations.Shout to God with the voice of triumph!

For Yahweh
Most High is awesome.He is a great King over all the earth.

He subdues
nations under us,and peoples under our feet.

He chooses
our inheritance for us,the glory of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.

God has
gone up with a shout,Yahweh with the sound of a trumpet.

Sing praises
to God! Sing praises!Sing praises to our King! Sing praises!

For God
is the King of all the earth.Sing praises with understanding.

God reigns
over the nations.God sits on his holy throne.

The princes
of the peoples are gathered together,the people of the God of Abraham.For the shields of the earth belong to God.He is greatly exalted!
